# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and platform reliability**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp release improves rendering reliability while updating Apple and Uno platform requirements. Android automatic texture rendering follows display refresh. Skia m156 fixes improve shader handling and Graphite correctness, while callback interoperability, Linux HarfBuzz coexistence, and WebAssembly linking receive fixes.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple application deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15, with managed minima aligned for Xcode 27 builds. Raise application deployment targets accordingly; retain any higher minimum required by your managed target or framework. .NET 9 targets remain supported. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno integrations to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI uses Uno 7's unified renderer and requires .NET 10 for its non-Windows assembly. Upgrade Uno and .NET together, use Uno.Sdk-provided platform native assets, and replace pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines with the .NET SDK WebAssembly path. Windows targets remain facades over SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering on non-Windows Uno** — On non-Windows Uno, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid and hosts a CPU-backed SKXamlCanvas. GRContext is null and PaintSurface supplies a raster surface with a size-and-format backend target whose framebuffer is zero. Use SKCanvasElement when you need GPU rendering, and remove uses of the dropped RaiseOnUnsupported member. The Windows ANGLE-backed control is unchanged. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Rebuild custom WebAssembly archives for WebGPU linking** — Newer WebAssembly consumers require libSkiaSharp.a to contain emdawnwebgpu's C++ support instead of compiling it during the application link. Use the rebuilt packaged archives or rebuild custom archives with GPU support; older and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy this contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is retained. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Pass one encoded unit to GetUnicodeCharacterCode** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates encoded byte width rather than UTF-16 string length. UTF-8 accepts only single-byte characters, UTF-16 one code unit, and UTF-32 one code point; empty, multi-character, and multi-unit inputs throw ArgumentException. Choose UTF-32 for supplementary characters or characters requiring multiple UTF-8 bytes. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Engine

- **More robust m156 shader and region handling** — Rejects overflowing Raster Pipeline slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier, sizes region storage for subdivided conics, and prevents execution of partially constructed runtime-shader pipelines. These are same-milestone fixes, not a new engine milestone. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))
- **Graphite stroke and paint correctness** — Graphite bounds account for cap and join inflation on hairlines and subpixel strokes, and paint-key equality compares the complete key rather than only a prefix. ([#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, rendering stays on the GL worker, and pause, resize, reattachment, and render-mode transitions preserve progress. This does not cap every RequestRender call or guarantee presentation timing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Correct native boolean callbacks** — Skia callbacks use the native one-byte boolean width and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values, fixing callback interoperability including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns. Public managed APIs and delegates continue to use bool; false glyph-name callbacks no longer copy a name buffer. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **HarfBuzz coexistence on Linux** — Bundled HarfBuzz function calls bind locally, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls through incompatible private objects and causing crashes or invalid-pointer errors. Exported entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Valid Ganesh GLES uploads** — Disables BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads advertised as GL_RGBA, which desktop GL accepted but GLES rejected. Readback behavior is unchanged. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Safer string handling** — Fixes a native buffer over-read in FromCString. StringUtilities.GetString now consistently throws ArgumentNullException for null byte arrays instead of dereferencing their Length first. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429), [#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower pixel-copy and text-conversion allocations** — Managed image pixel copies avoid intermediate SKData for valid direct-copy buffers while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp AddUtf32 avoids a per-call encoded byte array, and feature-string conversion avoids a native allocation while retaining existing decoding and legacy-target support. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention fix** — Fixes front-buffered stream retention. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows rendering dependencies** — Updates the bundled WinUI ANGLE dependency to chromium/8118 and aligns Windows library dependencies with MAUI 9 and 10 using Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. This does not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum or change public APIs. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
